description: Edits a TuneWorks maintenance reminder or service item. Deletes are not supported.

doneDate.description: Service completion date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Natural date strings are accepted but YYYY-MM-DD is preferred.

dueDate.description: Optional reminder date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Omit when no reminder is wanted.

name: update_maintenance

outputSchema.description: TuneWorks app object create/update result with the saved object and connected user.

status.description: Result status such as ok, created, updated, sent, auth_required, or confirmation_required.

tool.description: TuneWorks MCP tool name that produced this result.

title: Update maintenance
